reason: I run three agents a day and context does get lost switching between them, but Cursor and Copilot already keep context inside my editor, so I'm not paying thirty dollars a month for a new local daemon I haven't vetted on GitHub or Reddit — I'd use the free five humans first and probably never convert.
objection: Cursor/Copilot already do context sharing within my own editor, and I don't trust a brand-new daemon enough to install it and pay for it without seeing it discussed on Reddit and GitHub issues first.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing teams like mine vouch for it on Reddit/GitHub and a free trial that actually proves cross-tool context saves me time.
